verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe found https://clerk.com/openapi.json returning HTTP 200 with an "openapi" key, so a downloadable machine-readable OpenAPI spec exists. The docs confirm Clerk exposes a programmatic Backend API that such a spec would describe. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the spec (which APIs it covers, e.g. Backend vs. Frontend API, and its versioning), and independent corroboration that the spec is complete and usable.
